nodes.name: Weekly Trigger (Mon 7:30 AM IST)
nodes.notes:
Runs every Monday at 02:00 UTC = 07:30 IST. Source: screener_full.
Updates: All Screener.in data including per-FY financials (revenue/ebitda/pat/eps for FY23-FY25), ratios, balance sheet, quarterly P&L, shareholding, sectors.

nodes.name: Biweekly Trigger (1st & 15th, 8:30 AM IST)
nodes.notes:
Runs on 1st and 15th of every month at 03:00 UTC = 08:30 IST.
Sources: trendlyne + go_india_stocks (Selenium-based, slow).
Updates: target_price_high/low, consensus_target_price, revenue/ebitda/pat/eps estimates for FY26E-FY28E.

nodes.name: Monthly Trigger (1st of every month)
nodes.notes:
Runs on 1st of every month at 04:00 UTC = 09:30 IST.
The Code node filters for quarterly months only (Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct).
Sources: trendlyne + go_india_stocks + screener_full (FULL REFRESH).
Updates: ALL columns in equity_universe.

nodes.name: Daily Trigger (6:30 AM IST)
nodes.notes:
Runs daily at 01:00 UTC = 06:30 IST. Sources: yahoo_finance + screener_daily.
Updates: current_price, market_cap, volume, 52w high/low, returns, enterprise_value, dividend_yield, TTM P&L, ratios, balance sheet, quarterly results, sectors, shareholding.
